recipes.title: Mushroom and Spinach Toast
recipes.description: Buttery mushrooms and wilted spinach on toasted sourdough.

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms. Fry them in the butter over medium-high heat until golden.
Add the chopped garlic and spinach. Stir until the spinach wilts, then season.
Toast the bread and spoon the mushrooms and spinach over it.

recipes.notes: A squeeze of lemon brightens the mushrooms.
